slides.texte_overlay:
reasons to slow down
your whole life

you notice more

when you stop rushing, you start seeing the small beautiful things: light through a window, a funny sign, a kind face. a slow life is a much richer life.

you learn deeper

slow learning sticks far longer than cramming. a few calm minutes a day on something new beats hours of rushed scrolling. slow, steady curiosity is how real knowledge is built.
slides.texte_sophia:
you learn deeper

i used to rush through everything. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, slowly, a planet or a painting, and it stays with me so much longer.

slides.texte_overlay:
your decisions get better

rushed choices are often the ones you regret. giving yourself a little more time to think usually leads to calmer, wiser and kinder decisions overall.

your body thanks you

walking slower, eating slower and breathing slower all lower your stress. your body was never designed to sprint through every single day of your life.

people feel your calm

slow, calm people make everyone around them relax. your pace quietly sets the mood of the room, and others follow it without even noticing they're doing it.
